_note: The first dungeon: the old well, all the way down (scripts/dungeon/dungeon.gd, GameState's dungeon part, the adventures tab's dungeon page). It opens with feature:dungeon (the rope find at the well). An ARMY goes down floor by floor: the card pets you add (the best 'front_row' by power fight in front; the pinwheel perk adds to it, the rest walk behind) and plain pets from the herd picked by shelf. 'entrance.start' is how many pets fit through at once (the entrance is the first wisps perk: its steps in data/perks.json are added to this). A pet's POWER = its power stat (traits count) x power.rarity_x x power.finish_x x its own power knack; the herd's pets use their rarity's average stats. Pets walking behind (herd, and cards past the front row) count 'herd_x' of theirs, injured ones 'injured_x'; the whole army x the power boost (your active pet's knacks, data/boosts.json). A floor's STRENGTH = strength.base x strength.grow ^ floor (guard floors x guard_x). BANDS: 'rope' floors only let the front row fight; 'doors' floors: 'tiny' floors only let pets of 'tiny_from' rarity and up through, 'knock' floors roll luck first (knock_luck: base + per_luck x the front row's average luck stat, x the luck boost, at most max; a miss sends the army home with no pay for that floor); 'stairs' floors have a guard every 'guard_every'. A band shows on the well once the army has stood at its top (or an old save had its place open). LOSSES per floor: injure / ratio and lose / ratio^2 of the army (ratio = power / strength), each at most max_share; a floor below 'stuck' ratio can't be passed (its losses happen, no pay, everyone turns back). AWAY (the music box's runs while the game is closed): the army only goes as deep as floors where its ratio is at least 'away_safe' (2 = 'a stroll' or easier); nobody is lost or hurt on those, and it turns home before the first floor that isn't. Losses only happen while you're here. Losses take injured pets first, then anyone, until the first line of 'first' is earned (the deepest floor reaches first.earn_floor): then 'who goes first' picks (plain ones = the herd, anyone, the front row = cards). PAY for each cleared floor: pay.base x pay.grow ^ floor x pets SENT (at most the entrance), rounded, at least 1; never per pet lost. 'seconds_per_floor' is how long a floor takes; 'target_ahead' how far past the deepest floor the orders may aim. 'home_at' are the steps of 'come home when X% are gone'. 'words' are the feeling words for a floor: the first whose ratio the army reaches, with a heat ('' quiet, 'mid', 'hot'); strength is never shown as a number. 'firsts' happen the first time a floor is cleared: a part of 'tier', or a find (the key on 20 stays hidden until then; 'say' is your pet's one quiet line). 'currency' is the darker currency's word and colour role. HELD LANDINGS ('hold'): every 'every'th landing the army has cleared can be held by a crowd of plain pets sent by shelf (the new homes stall's rules: never favourites, your pet, the army, holo and better); 'need' is how many for the 1st, 2nd, 3rd held landing, then x 'grow' each (24k, 72k...); the card's stepper steps need / 'steps_to_fill'. A fully held landing is a place the orders can 'start from': the floors above it are skipped (no fights, no losses, no lanterns, no time). Holders stay on for good (no night-sky star). 'what' they hold by the band's kind; 'faces' is the most tiny pets drawn in a crowd on the well, 'card_faces' in the hold card's crowd, 'looks' how many different stand-in looks a crowd mixes. Every number is a placeholder.

20.say: there was a tiny key on floor 20. i'm keeping it safe for us.
